items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: video-use 是一个基于 Claude Code 的开源视频编辑工具，通过 ElevenLabs Scribe 转录获取带时间戳的文本，配合对需求的 timeline_view 可视化合成，以 12KB 文本替代直接处理数万视频帧。支持自动去除填充词和停顿、自适应调色、30ms 音频淡入淡出、风格化字幕烧录，并通过 HyperFrames、Remotion 等子代理并行生成动画叠加。
items.summary_en: **video-use** is a 100% open-source tool that edits videos through natural language chat with Claude Code (or other agents like Codex, Hermes). Users drop raw footage into a folder, then describe desired edits—removing filler words, auto color grading, burning subtitles, adding animations—while the agent handles transcription via ElevenLabs Scribe, renders the final.mp4, and self-evaluates output at each cut boundary. Setup requires cloning the repo, installing ffmpeg, and registering an ElevenLabs API key.

items.title: Show HN: DeltaCode – Pure AST beat Qwen's zvec-grep on our test (92% vs 48%)
items.summary: DeltaCode 是一个基于纯 AST（抽象语法树）的编码代理上下文构建工具，不使用向量数据库或 embedding 模型，仅通过 Go 符号、签名、函数体等结构化信息对可能的实现位置进行排序。在 25 个任务的私有 Go 仓库测试中，其 path Recall@5 达到 92%，显著高于 zvec-grep 的 40% 和 48%。当前 v0.1 版本支持 discover、
items.summary_en: DeltaCode is a Go-based coding agent tool that ranks implementation sites using deterministic AST analysis instead of embeddings, achieving 92% path Recall@5 versus 48% for zvec-grep on a private 25-case Go repository benchmark. It operates with zero dependencies on vector databases, embedding models, or network access, exposing discover, slice, and context-for-task functions via an MCP server. The v0.1 release supports Go function/method indexing and both Go and Python AST slicing under Apache 2.0.

items.title: Beyond the Chatbot: Building Production AI Systems on AWS
items.summary_en: Building production AI systems goes far beyond simple LLM API calls, requiring orchestration layers for agents, tools, memory, RAG pipelines, guardrails, and observability. On AWS, Amazon Bedrock provides managed foundation model access, while S3, RDS/DynamoDB, OpenSearch/pgvector, Lambda/ECS, SQS/EventBridge, CloudWatch, and IAM/Secrets Manager address storage, retrieval, compute, async workflows, monitoring, and security. AI agents introduce additional complexity around tool calling, state management, failure handling, and human-in-the-loop controls, while production reliability demands strategies for timeouts, rate limits, hallucinations, idempotency, and outages.

items.title: Show HN: PuPPT – slide renderer and inline editor for PPT/PPTX (Golang/no deps)
items.summary: PuPPT 是一个基于 Go 语言的零依赖 CLI 工具，用于对 PowerPoint .pptx 文件进行检查、编辑、验证和渲染。其标准工作流为 inspect → plan → edit → validate → review → render，支持文本/图片修改、幻灯片增删改查等操作，且通过纯 Go 实现的渲染器生成 PNG，无需调用 LibreOffice 或 PowerPoint 等外部工具。
items.summary_en: PuPPT is a Go CLI tool that inspects, edits, validates, and renders editable PowerPoint (.pptx) files by treating them as structured Open XML packages rather than screenshots. It enables a workflow of inspecting decks to JSON, planning targeted mutations, applying supported edits without touching unrelated content, and rendering slides to PNG through a built-in Go renderer—no shelling out to LibreOffice, PowerPoint, or browser tools. Core commands include inspect, plan, edit, validate, review, and render, with ambiguous or unsupported changes rejected pre-mutation to preserve deck integrity.

items.title: handsomestWei/patent-disclosure-skill
items.summary: "中国专利.skill"是一款支持发明、实用新型、外观设计三类专利挖掘与交底书编写的AI技能，可通过自然语言按发明人/申请人检索国知局公开专利清单，自动完成查新、脱敏、成文，并支持从设计文档、代码甚至STEP/CAD模型中提取结构图或外观线稿嵌入交底书。该技能还配备专利通俗解读功能，可将晦涩的权利要求转化为通俗笔记与知识图谱存入Obsidian，形成可关联、可检索的个人专利情报库；并集成政策雷达与审查答复辅助，自动跟踪审查动向、沉淀历史案例并生成意见陈述草稿。
items.summary_en: 中国专利.skill is an AI-powered tool for Chinese patent workflow automation, supporting invention, utility model, and design patent types. It automates patent point mining, disclosure document generation (with mermaid diagrams, SVG structure figures, and CAD-projection line art), prior-art search via CNIPA, and plain-language patent interpretation integrated with Obsidian knowledge graphs. It also provides policy change monitoring and an examination-response assistant that uses tag-based and optional vector-RAG retrieval over historical office actions.

items.title: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
items.summary: VoltAgent维护的awesome-design-md是收录了真实品牌DESIGN.md文件的开源集合，GitHub排名全球第150位。DESIGN.md是由Google Stitch引入的纯文本设计系统规范，AI编码代理可读取该markdown文件生成与品牌设计语言一致的UI，无需Figma导出或JSON Schema。该仓库涵盖Claude、Cohere、Cursor、Vercel等AI平台与开发者工具的设计解析，支持开发者一键复制至项目让AI自动生成匹配UI。
items.summary_en: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md is a curated GitHub collection of DESIGN.md files—plain-text markdown design system documents originally introduced by Google Stitch—that AI coding agents use to generate visually consistent UIs. The repo offers ready-to-use files extracted from real websites like Vercel, Cursor, and ElevenLabs, eliminating the need for Figma exports or JSON schemas. Users can also request custom DESIGN.md files for specific sites, including private requests.

items.title: Show HN: Redactle LLM Leaderboard
items.summary: Redactle LLM Leaderboard 对多个大语言模型在 Redactle 游戏中的表现进行了评测，Gemini Flash 在准确性和成本上均大幅领先。该模型仅需单次调用、几秒内即可完成所有评测任务，性能优势显著。
items.summary_en: The Redactle LLM Leaderboard evaluates how well language models play the word-guessing game Redactle. Gemini Flash emerged as the top performer, capable of one-shotting every evaluation in just a few seconds while also being the most cost-effective option.

items.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
items.summary: OpenAI新一代模型Astra采用名为"循环深度"（opaque recurrence）的推理技术，允许模型以非线性循环方式处理查询，而非传统单线程推理。该技术在提升推理效率的同时，使模型的思维链更难追踪，引发Redwood CEO Buck Shlegeris等安全专家强烈担忧，Anthropic和Google DeepMind也已开始讨论该技术。OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki回应称，公司将持续保留可监控的思维
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Astra model uses a "recurrent depth" (or "opaque recurrence") reasoning technique that processes queries in non-sequential loops, raising concerns among AI safety experts that it could undermine chain-of-thought monitoring. Redwood CEO Buck Shlegeris and other safety advocates warned the technique risks making AI reasoning harder to track, though OpenAI says Astra's use is limited and chain-of-thought legibility remains a core commitment. Anthropic and Google DeepMind are reportedly also exploring the technique.
